A colossal crimson-scaled fire dragon, armored plates glowing molten at the seams, twin sweeping black horns and a jagged dorsal crest, vast ribbed wings with deep-red membranes, a smoldering throat and smoke curling from its fanged maw, long spike-tipped tail.

A frost-blue dragon sheathed in frost-rimed scales and crystalline ice-spines down its spine, pale translucent wing-membranes glittering, curved white horns, breath fogging cold in the air, a long whip-tail tipped with an ice-shard fan.

An obsidian-black dragon with matte armored scales and blood-red wing-membranes, a crown of back-swept horns, amber slit eyes, muscular shoulders and a barbed tail, every plate edged with a faint ember glow.

A bronze-gold dragon with burnished overlapping scales catching the light like hammered metal, a sweeping fan of six curved horns, broad amber-tinted wing-membranes, a thick muscular neck and a heavy club-ended tail trailing sparks.

An emerald forest dragon encrusted with moss and lichen between its scales, a rack of branching antler-like horns, deep-green wing-membranes threaded with leaf-vein patterns, thick limbs gripping bark, a long tail coiled around ancient roots.

A storm-grey dragon crackling with arcs of violet static across its jagged ridge-scales, forked lightning-bolt horns, gunmetal wing-membranes shot with electric blue veins, eyes blazing white, every wingbeat releasing a thunderclap and the smell of ozone.

A bone-white dragon with desiccated parchment-thin scales and tattered, hole-riddled wing-membranes of pale ivory, a cluster of chipped spiral horns, sunken dark eye sockets, a skeletal frame belying enormous coiled strength, and a whip-thin barbed tail.

A molten-veined volcanic dragon with basalt-black scales cracked along every seam to reveal rivers of orange magma beneath, stubby obsidian horns, deep-crimson wing-membranes glowing from within, a throat pulsing with liquid fire, steam rising from its back.

A deep-sea teal dragon with overlapping iridescent scales shimmering like wet abalone, sweeping fin-frills along its jaw and spine, translucent aquamarine wing-membranes veined in silver, long rear fins on its muscular tail, bioluminescent eyes glowing pale green.

A royal-purple dragon crowned with a magnificent spray of iridescent feathered crest plumes framing its horned reptilian skull, violet scaled armor, broad wing-membranes of deep plum edged in gold, a regal long tail bearing a feathered tip.

A sandy-gold desert dragon with rough granular scales like sandstone, swept-back ram-curved horns bleached pale, wide ochre wing-membranes cracked and sun-weathered, a flattened spade tail leaving furrows, heat shimmer rising from its baking plated shoulders.

A silver-white celestial dragon with mirror-polished scales reflecting the sky, a tall single spiraling horn flanked by two short ridged ones, gossamer wing-membranes of pale silver that cast prismatic light, eyes like molten moonlight, tail ending in a starburst cluster.

A deep-crimson and midnight-blue twilight dragon with scales that shift color depending on angle, twin corkscrew horns tipped with silver, translucent wing-membranes swirling with nebula-like purples, a long tail tipped with a glowing orb of dim starlight.

A venomous chartreuse dragon with slick glistening scales dripping with caustic fluid, curved backward-hooking horns mottled black, sickly yellow-green wing-membranes laced with dark veins, a fat ridged tail, pools of smoking venom collecting beneath its clawed feet.

A rust-red ironclad dragon plated in thick overlapping scales like ancient corroded armor, blunt squared-off horns edged with orange oxide, dark terracotta wing-membranes stretched taut over iron-hard ribs, a massive spiked tail like a medieval war-flail.

A ghostly pale-lavender dragon with translucent opalescent scales that reveal shadowy muscle beneath, tall swept ethereal horns of bone-white, gossamer lavender wing-membranes like moth wings, eyes of solid silver, a long sinuous tail that fades to near-invisible.

A midnight-blue arctic dragon with scales rimmed in ice-crystal frost patterns, a crown of icicle-sharp blue-white horns, vast wing-membranes of deep midnight veined with frozen silver cracks, steaming freezing breath, a heavy tail dragging frost across stone.

A copper-rust autumn dragon with scales patterned in deep orange, red, and brown like fallen leaves, a cluster of antler-tine horns mottled amber, warm amber wing-membranes like stained glass backlit by fire, tail tip fanned like a maple leaf.

A pitch-black void dragon with scales that absorb all light like a hole in the world, smooth and featureless, horns of pure darkness barely visible, wing-membranes of absolute black edged in faint violet, eyes twin white pinpoints, silence following its every step.

A deep-magenta coral dragon with ridged bony scales in brilliant pink and white, branching horn-spines like staghorn coral, wing-membranes of sheer rose-gold shot with capillary-red veins, a broad flat tail finned in brilliant orange, trailing sea-mist.

A mottled jungle-green and gold dragon with camouflaged scale patterns mimicking sunlit canopy, curling ram horns speckled gold, wide leaf-green wing-membranes with golden vein-lines, a long heavy tail bearing sharp bone-edged spines, tropical flowers tangled at its feet.

A pale amber fossil dragon with scales etched with ancient crack-patterns like crumbling stone, swept petrified horns of granite-grey, brittle-looking parchment-yellow wing-membranes ribbed like carved rock, eyes of polished amber containing frozen insects, tail ending in a stone mace-knob.

A blazing white solar dragon with scales radiating intense golden-white heat haze, a tall flared crest of radiant spines behind its horned skull, wing-membranes burning white-gold like sunlit glass, eyes of pure blinding gold, every exhale a pillar of white fire.

A chrome-silver storm-forged dragon with interlocking metallic scales like riveted plate armor, twin straight lance-like horns, rigid wing-membranes of burnished steel-grey ribbed with silver, eyes of glowing red, tailblade sharp as a greatsword, lightning reflecting across its whole body.

A deep-indigo shadow dragon with velvet-soft matte scales swallowing torchlight, curving ram horns of polished black obsidian, enormous wing-membranes of midnight-indigo edged in deep violet, near-invisible in darkness save for its glowing twin ember-orange eyes and faintly phosphorescent tail-tip.
